_comment: Faction colour sets. Applying one writes the three palette channels and the material preset, leaving per-part colour overrides untouched, so a faction repaint never destroys hand-picked detail colours.

factions.name: Crimson Vanguard
factions.desc: Punchy racecar red with bright canary yellow armor plates and dark slate trim. Classic bold cartoon red faction.

factions.name: Solar Corsairs
factions.desc: Blazing hotrod orange with sunshine yellow panels and sleek gloss obsidian trim. Bold cartoon orange faction.

factions.name: Cobalt Federation
factions.desc: Heroic brilliant royal blue with safety orange wings and arctic white trim. Bold cartoon blue faction.

factions.name: Emerald Syndicate
factions.desc: Vibrant cartoon lime-green with royal purple armor plates and gold trim. Bold cartoon green faction.

factions.name: Amethyst Void
factions.desc: Deep royal electric purple with hot magenta flares and electric cyan edges. Bold cartoon purple faction.

factions.name: Cyber Teal Enforcers
factions.desc: Fluorescent cyan-teal with hot coral pink striping and glossy midnight trim.

factions.name: Vega Yellow Fleet
factions.desc: High-visibility bumblebee yellow with bold hazard black panels and safety orange highlights.

factions.name: Neon Turbo Racers
factions.desc: High-octane electric magenta with neon cyan and laser yellow trim. Flashy, vibrant, and impossible to miss.

factions.name: Terran Coalition Navy
factions.desc: Deep royal navy blue with electric cyan accents and clean white hull plates.

factions.name: Free Traders' Union
factions.desc: Warm golden amber with jade green flashes and slate structural trim.

factions.name: Crimson Outlaws
factions.desc: High-contrast vermilion red with hazard yellow stripes and soot black plates.

factions.name: Kethral Compact
factions.desc: Deep alien violet shell with glowing turquoise channel lines and magenta trim.

factions.name: Arctic Interceptors
factions.desc: Crisp stormtrooper white hull with electric blue racing stripes and dark carbon trim.

factions.name: Solana Livery
factions.desc: Bought with SKR. Solana violet with mint-green panels and a near-black trim.

factions.name: Seeker Livery
factions.desc: Bought with SKR. Bone-white hull, Seeker teal accents, graphite trim.

factions.name: 24 Karat Livery
factions.desc: Bought with SKR. Polished gold with cream highlights and a deep bronze trim.

factions.name: Genesis Livery
factions.desc: Seeker Genesis pilots only. Graphite hull, champagne-gold panels, a Seeker-teal trim.
